relevance_note: Reports four HA20 patients from two Chinese families with heterozygous TNFAIP3 variants: 'WES revealed heterozygous c.559C > T(p.Q187X) mutation in the TNFAIP3 gene (RS:NM_006290) in P1, P2 and P3', and 'The c.259C > T (p.R87X) mutation in the TNFAIP3 gene (RS:NM_006290) was identified in P4'.
method_note: Read the whole paper manually; built the JSON with a short Python script in the scratch directory. Values were typed by hand from the paper (no automatic table parsing); spans were matched to the paper by script (thin spaces U+2009 and no-break spaces restored from the source) and every span was verified verbatim. Labels: the text uses P1-P4 ('The proband 1 (P1)', 'Patient 2 (P2)' etc.); Tables 1-2 use rows 1-4 (columns 'Patient no'/'No'); Table 3 has patients as columns, header 'Case 1 | | Case 2 | | Case 4' with Pretherapy/posttherapy sub-columns (no column for P3). Table 3 spans quote the whole row, including the normal range. Table 3 pretherapy values outside the printed normal range were recorded as observed features (posttherapy values only as detail). Table 2 'No' cells were recorded as excluded organ-level features and used for checklist exclusions only where the item is not broader than the column (e.g. Cardiovascular: No was not used to exclude 'pericarditis or other serositis'). Group statement 'All patients had no signs of eye or skin problems, such as uveitis, rash, folliculitis and dermal abscess' was applied to all four patients as 'inferred from group statement'. Checklist abstentions by design: P1 hypothyroidism not called autoimmune thyroiditis; P1 cytopenias with positive Coombs test not called autoimmune; P1 pericardial effusion/ascites not called pericarditis or serositis; P2 and P4 'fever of unknown origin' not called recurrent; P3 anal fistula (archosyrinx, listed under Intestinal) not called GI ulcer or inflammation. Unaffected tested relatives (family 1 mother and grandparents, P4's parents) were not given rows: the paper mentions them only as groups ('other members in family 1', 'her parents') with no individual data. CONTRADICTIONS: (1) Fig. 2 legend panels e and f say knee synovitis and ILD are 'in P3', but the text cites Fig. 2e and 2f for P4, Table 2 gives P3 lung 'No', and P3 'refused further assessment'; both P3 rows were emitted (ILD observed and lung: No excluded) and P3's ILD checklist item set to not reported; P3 knee synovitis emitted as observed from the legend only. (2) P4 oral ulcers: text 'referred ... due to oral ulcers' vs Table 2 Ulcers 'No'; both rows emitted, checklist not reported; P4 genital ulcers left not reported because the only evidence is that contradicted cell. (3) P4 anti-dsDNA: text 'positive ANA and anti-ds DNA antibodies' at referral vs 'no other autoantibody was detected in her serum' and Table 3 Anti-dsDNA '–'; both rows emitted (ANA positivity keeps the autoantibody checklist item observed). (4) P1 anti-dsDNA: Table 3 '+' pretherapy vs text 'other autoantibodies were negative'; both rows emitted. (5) P2 age at onset: text 'polyarthritis at age 2.6' vs Table 1 '2.5 years'; individuals table uses Table 1. (6) P4 ages: text '9-year-old girl' and onset 'at the age of 7 years' vs Table 1 current age 8.3 years and onset 6.9 years; individuals table uses Table 1. (7) P2 Table 2 Ulcers 'No' although endoscopy found 'multiple ulcers ... on the gastrointestinal tract'; the column was read as oral/genital ulcers and no GI-ulcer exclusion was recorded. (8) P4 Table 2 Liver 'No' although ALT/AST were increased; autoimmune hepatitis kept excluded from the Table 2 cell. (9) The group statement excludes 'dermal abscess' while P2 had a perianal abscess (listed under Intestinal); not treated as a contradiction. (10) P2 current treatment: text lists etanercept, Etiasa and MTX; Table 1 also lists prednisolone. Other notes: Hemoglobin is printed as g/dl with normal range 110–160 (units as printed). P3 de novo status rests on 'not detected in other members in family 1' plus the authors' conclusion; P3's parents are not explicitly named as tested. c.559C>T (p.Q187X) is said to have been 'reported by other study [16]' (variant, not the same patients). No variants in other genes were reported.
